reddit.title: Improved Music Transitions in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to the music transitions in Provincia! No more hard cuts between day, night, title, and combat beds. Our new long equal-power self-crossfade technique ensures a smoother listening experience. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops

steam.title: Enhanced Audio Experience in Provincia
steam.body: We're excited to announce a major audio update in Provincia! The music now features smooth transitions between day, night, title, and combat beds, eliminating the hard cuts you may have noticed before. This improvement enhances your immersion in the game. For more details, visit our devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
